metadata.task: Track 2, Step 3.4.1: Binary Training Runner Implementation & Independent Readiness Audit
metadata.auditor: Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer and Independent Experimental Auditor

1_training_plan_revalidation.details: Dataset ordering audited; dual deterministic sampling strategies supported (source-stratified 50/50 and sequential 1000). Zero train-val document leakage.

2_runner_implementation.details: Complete implementation with DeBERTa-v3-small architecture, offline tokenizer, batch size 1, seq len 128, AdamW (lr 2e-5, decay 0.01), 100-step warmup.

3_input_serialization.details: Text A = Query + Evidence Context; Text B = Candidate Output Response. NLI premise/hypothesis terminology strictly avoided.

4_safety_watchdogs.details: Active per-step watchdog enforcing: RAM >= 700 MB, swap growth <= 500 MB, free swap >= 1000 MB, wall-clock <= 1800 s, 4 CPU threads, fail-fast on breach.

5_checkpoint_safety.details: Atomic directory staging prevents corruption; strict security check blocks overwriting pretrained model directory.

6_evaluation_metrics.details: Loss, accuracy, balanced accuracy, precision/recall/F1 per class, macro F1, and 2x2 confusion matrix implemented. Zero abstention semantics.

8_test_set_isolation.details: Strict prohibition enforced at record and file level; attempts to target test files or records raise SecurityViolationError.

remaining_conditions: User must issue explicit instruction/command authorizing execution.
